nodes.name: Filter Delete Action for Same Business Partner Relationship
Filter Delete Action for Same Business Partner Relationship

PrePostProcessing.groovy.purpose: Remove duplicate BusinessPartnerRelationship delete messages (actionCode=05) when a corresponding update message (actionCode=04) exists with the same partner and relationship identifiers.
PrePostProcessing.groovy.business_note: This deduplication rule removes actionCode='05' (delete) records when a matching actionCode='04' (update) record exists. This prevents duplicate delete operations when both appear in the same incoming batch. All identifier fields must match for deduplication to occur.
